about.title: About CubingSP
about.intro: CubingSP was born from the union of competitors and organizers across the state of São Paulo with one goal: strengthening speedcubing in the state.
about.historyText: São Paulo hosts one of the most active speedcubing communities in Brazil, with official WCA championships held regularly across the state. CubingSP exists to give this community structure: centralizing information, supporting organizers and representing competitors.
about.mission1: Grow the number of official competitions in the state of São Paulo.
about.mission2: Maintain state rankings and give visibility to local competitors.
about.mission3: Build open tools for delegates and organizers.
about.mission4: Bring new cubers into the competitive community.

rankings.title: State Ranking
rankings.text: Who scored the most points at official WCA competitions in the state of São Paulo, year by year since 2007, overall and in each event.
rankings.howText: The APS (Portuguese Speedcubing Association) method, the same one used by RASCS. In each round, counting Brazilians only, a competitor earns:
rankings.scope: Every round of every official WCA competition held in the state of São Paulo counts. Only Brazilians (from any state) are ranked: competitors from other countries are disregarded, and each round's places and number of competitors are recalculated among Brazilians only. Multi-location competitions (common in FMC) are left out, because results don't say which venue each person competed at.
rankings.credits: Ranking computed by CubingSP based on RASCS (github.com/MatheusCasassa/rascs).
